name: spec-principles-prompts
body: The distributed agent prompt files that carry the spec rules R1–R5: the writer prompts `opencode-suite/agents/spec-writer.md`, `plan-writer.md`, and `codebase-navigator.md`, and the reviewer prompts `spec-review.md`, `plan-review.md`, and `implementation-phase-reviewer.md`. All six are product source embedded into the `apg` binary via `include_str!` and installed by `apg init` into `~/.opencode/agents/`. The prompt surface carries the rules; the deterministic enforcement is the separate `solution.component.spec-lint` (the `apg spec lint` subcommand and its suite tool).
